_doc: What the bot may do with a Safe vault, per venue. vault/roles.mjs compiles a venue's rules
plus 'payout' into the scopes of one Zodiac Roles v2 role (the bot's key is its only member).
Every call is a plain call: no value, no delegatecall. A function not listed here cannot run.
target: the contract the call goes to
poolToken     each token of each approved pool
payoutToken   each token of an approved pool that the chain lists as a stable (the payout token)
npm, router   the chain module's NonfungiblePositionManager and SwapRouter02
params: one entry per argument of the signature, in order; "any" allows every argument.
avatar        the Safe itself: what a call pays or mints goes nowhere else
spender       the position manager or the router
payout        one of the payout wallets the owners approved
token0, token1, fee   the approved pool's own (the whole tuple must match ONE approved pool)
pairToken     either token of that same pool
[ ... ]       a tuple argument, one entry per field
{"perPool": [ ... ]}   a tuple whose fields name a pool: it must match one approved pool
Not allowed, on purpose: increaseLiquidity (it adds to ANY position id, a stranger's too),
multicall (its inner calls would not be checked), and every approve to anyone else.

functions.name: approve the position manager or the router
mint a position on an approved pool, to the Safe
take liquidity out of a position (it stays owed to the position)
collect what a position owes, to the Safe
swap on an approved pool, to the Safe

payout.name: pay out to a payout wallet
